name: CertifyMe
definition: CertifyMe is an institutional digital credential platform connecting authorized issuance, verification, skills and learner-record context.
relationship: The provider of credential infrastructure; product certification applies to listed standards roles, not every institutional outcome.

name: Digital Credential Infrastructure
definition: Processes and systems for authorized award approval, issuance, verification, lifecycle maintenance and related record interfaces.
relationship: Coordinates credentials and their verification resources with reviewed skills, learner records and separately sourced workforce context.

name: Digital Credentials
definition: Digital records of issuer claims about an achievement, with contextual information such as issuer, criteria and evidence.
relationship: Individual achievement evidence that can be presented as badges or certificates and connected in a learner record.

name: Open Badges 3.0
definition: A 1EdTech achievement credential standard with structured issuer, earner, criteria and evidence information in a verifiable-credential context.
relationship: A specific achievement profile, not simply a badge image or universal receiver guarantee.

name: W3C Verifiable Credentials
definition: A data model for structured issuer claims and issuer, holder and verifier roles, used with an appropriate securing mechanism.
relationship: General model underlying achievement profiles; proof, identity assurance and truth of claims remain distinct.

name: Skills Taxonomy
definition: An organized vocabulary of skill or competency concepts; mapping relates institutional terminology and evidence to reviewed concepts.
relationship: Interprets achievement meaning without replacing assessment or making a title match proof of competence.

name: Comprehensive Learner Record
definition: A structured record connecting a learner's achievements with their issuers, evidence and provenance; the CLR Standard specifies interoperable representations.
relationship: Connects achievement records while preserving each component's authority and lifecycle context.

name: Workforce Intelligence
definition: Institutional analysis relating reviewed learning evidence and skills to occupations and separately sourced employer demand.
relationship: Adds occupational and market context; it is not assessment evidence, a guarantee of employment or a learner job board.

name: Skill Passport
definition: CertifyMe's learner-facing presentation of connected achievements and skills, through the SkillStory experience described on its university page.
relationship: A presentation of evidence, not a separate technical standard, new qualification, independent identity document or employment guarantee.
